big_picture.title: Nasdaq Charges Higher As CoreWeave Pops; Nvidia Stumbles Amid More Huang Revelations
big_picture.excerpt: AI stocks rally as Nasdaq posts a follow-through day.
paragraphs: The artificial intelligence trade got its mojo back Wednesday, with a lot of help from neocloud data-center name CoreWeave (CRWV). Gains were broad as the Nasdaq scored a follow-through day, confirming a nascent stock market uptrend.
The tech-dominated index popped 1.6%, clearing its 200-day moving average. The S&P 500 index closed a touch below its 21-day moving average with a 1.3% climb.
